name: io.github.ghstaking/bentcrypto-mcp
title: BentCrypto x402 Token Intelligence
description: BentCrypto MCP bridge for x402 Token Risk on Solana/Base and Token Security on Solana.

environmentVariables.name: BENTCRYPTO_ALLOW_PAYMENTS
environmentVariables.description: Set to YES only after reviewing the live x402 challenge and funding a dedicated payment wallet.

environmentVariables.name: BENTCRYPTO_MAX_USDC_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Local maximum USDC spend per call; the bridge defaults to 0.01.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Dedicated Base payment wallet private key. Keep only in the MCP host environment.

environmentVariables.name: SVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Dedicated Solana payment wallet private key. Keep only in the MCP host environment.
